title: Vase - Twirl Essence
author: Fabian_S1991
description:
This elegant spiral vase, named _Twirl Essence_, is a minimalist yet eye-catching piece designed for 3D printing enthusiasts. Created in the "Spiral Vase Mode," it is both lightweight and time-efficient to print, making it ideal for quick decor upgrades. With its smooth, flowing curves, this vase is perfect for displaying dried flowers or as a standalone art piece. Please note, while visually stunning, the vase may not be fully waterproof and is best suited for non-liquid displays.

Powered by MakerWorld-Make My Vase (https://makerworld.com/makerlab/makeMyVase)
